# Sunil Hanamshetty — Product Manager | Consumer Growth and Fintech

Two-time founder with an engineering base, based in Bengaluru. At Triveni, Sunil runs the full product loop on a live learning app. His earlier work includes Yelow's auto-loan journey and Flutter features for Isha Foundation's Miracle of Mind.

## Experience

- Triveni, Founder & Product Lead (May 2025 to Present): Deprioritized AI Notes after SQL cohort and funnel analysis, then shifted to teacher-led quizzes. Mixpanel D1 retention was 15% in an earlier period and 28% in a later period. Built a teacher-led model with 32 active creators; 19 returned to create content at least 8 weeks after their first record. Reached 259 peak WAU. Early Rs 10/20 gated quizzes and later Rs 399/599 CET courses reached 22 paying customers and Rs 7,744 gross. Built an Agno PDF-to-notes-and-quizzes pipeline with an LLM-as-judge accuracy check.
- Isha Foundation, Product Engineer (Product & UX) (Jun 2024 to Mar 2025): Owned Flutter audio listening, sharing, quote capture, and profiles for Miracle of Mind, which crossed 1M downloads in its first 24 hours. Built a remote feature switch to hide Sadhguru Wisdom if its third-party API failed under launch traffic.
- Yelow, Software Engineer (Loan Origination Product) (Jan 2023 to Jun 2024): Sole frontend engineer for the auto-loan journey from OTP, PAN, Aadhaar and CKYC through income checks, calculator and disbursal. Built admin-triggered KYC failure recovery. Integrated 10+ bank and KYC partners, including OneMoney Account Aggregator and OCR checks, for a 500-user pilot. Shipped a demand-test landing page in seven days.
- Mignon, Co-founder (Jan 2022 to Aug 2023; part-time from Jan 2023): Conducted 20+ salon-owner interviews to shape the MVP, shipped requested push notifications, and supported onboarded salons while exploring viability.

## Project

- LabLens (Jun 2026): One-day hackathon build. Blood report images/PDFs become plain-language, colour-coded results in under 10 seconds. A five-report eval set exposed false urgent flags, so Sunil raised the threshold. MVP covered one report format, with no accounts or history to preserve the no-storage promise.

- Harvard CS50 online — Introduction to Computer Science (Sep 2021).
